review: DAENEM Staff Portal Procurement zero-disclosure review

finding.summary: A company member without Procurement approval could distinguish an existing purchase order from a missing one, and idempotency evidence lookup was not company scoped.
finding.correction: Purchase-order existence and approval checks now fail closed with the same neutral 404 response. Idempotency evidence is constrained by the authoritative purchase-order company.

reviewer.result: PASS for this bounded Procurement security change; authenticated V45 browser acceptance remains separately pending.
